name: Soya Soslu Hazır Noodle
truth: Noodles: Wheat Flour (Gluten), Vegetable Oil (Palm), Salt, Acidity Regulator (Potassium Carbonate, Sodium Polyphospate, Sodium Carbonate), Thickener (Guar Gum), Colouring Agent (Riboflavin). Seasoning Powder: Sugar, Salt, Flavour Enhancer (Monosodium Glutamate) Garlic Powder, Artificial Beef Flavour Powder, Onion Powder, Yeast Extract (Saccharomyces cerevisiae), Caramel. Chili Powder. Oil: Vegetable Oil (Palm), Onion, Sweet Soy Sauce (Contains Sesame). (< %2). Allergen: Contains Wheat Protein (Gluten), Soy Bean and Sesame
note: No "Ingredients" heading on this crop: Morsel reads nothing (missed, not wrong).
